On 22 April, [[Neom SC|Neom]] became the first team to be promoted following a 3–0 away win against [[Al-Arabi SC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Arabi]].{{cite web |title=رسميا.. نيوم يصعد إلى دوري روشن لأول مرة في تاريخه |url=https://www.kooora.com/?n=1403882}} They were crowned champions following a 6–0 away win against [[Jeddah Club|Jeddah]] on 29 April.{{cite web |title=رسميًا.. نيوم يحسم دوري يلو |url=https://www.al-madina.com/article/932580/%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B6%D8%A9/%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%88}} They set the record for the most points and most wins in a 34–league game season and set the record for most goals scored in a season. On 12 May, [[Al-Najma SC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Najma]] became the second club to be promoted following a 2–0 home win against [[Ohod Club|Ohod]].{{cite web |title=المرة الأولى.. النجمة يصعد إلى دوري المحترفين |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/866139}} On 29 May, [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] became the third and final club to be promoted after defeating [[Al-Adalah FC|Al-Adalah]] 3–0 in the promotion play-offs final.{{cite web |title=بعد فوزه على العدالة في الملحق.. الحزم يحجز آخر مقاعد الصعود إلى دوري المحترفين |url=https://spa.gov.sa/N2330574}} On 28 April, [[Ohod Club|Ohod]] became the first team to be relegated after a 1–1 draw with Al-Adalah.{{cite web |title=المرة الخامسة.. أُحد يهبط إلى الثانية |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/865222}} On 6 May, [[Al Safa FC|Al-Safa]] became the second team to be relegated following a 4–1 home defeat to Al-Arabi.{{cite web |title=الصفا يرافق أُحُد لـ«الثانية».. والهبوط يهدد 4 أندية |url=https://www.okaz.com.sa/sport/saudi/2195434}} On 12 May, [[Al-Ain FC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Ain]] became the third and the final club to be relegated following a 2–2 draw with Al-Faisaly.{{cite web |title=اكتمال ثلاثي الهبوط رسميًا من دوري يلو إلى الثانية |url=https://www.alyaum.com/article/6593950}} ==Overview== ===Changes=== On 21 June 2024, the [[Saudi Arabian Football Federation|FDL]] announced the introduction of a play-off system to determine the third team to be promoted to the Saudi Pro League. Teams placed between third and sixth position took part in the promotion play-offs. The fifth-placed would face the fourth, while the sixth-placed team would face the third. The final would be single-legged, hosted by the higher-placed team.{{cite web |title="PLAY-OFF» يحدد صاعدي «يلو" |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/842858/}} ===Team changes=== The following teams have changed division since the 2023–24 season. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} ===To the First Division League=== '''Promoted from [[2023–24 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Neom SC|Neom]] * [[Al-Jubail Club|Al-Jubail]] * [[Al-Zulfi FC|Al-Zulfi]] '''Relegated from [[2023–24 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Abha Club|Abha]] * [[Al-Tai FC|Al-Tai]] * [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] {{col-break|gap=3em}} ===From the First Division League=== '''Promoted to [[2024–25 Saudi Pro League|Pro League]]''' * [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] * [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]] * [[Al-Kholood Club|Al-Kholood]] '''Relegated to [[2024–25 Saudi Second Division League|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Qaisumah FC|Al-Qaisumah]] * [[Hajer FC|Hajer]] * [[Al-Taraji Club|Al-Taraji]] {{col-end}} ==Teams== A total of 18 teams will be contesting the league, including 12 sides from the [[2023–24 Saudi First Division League|2023–24 season]], the three promoted teams from the [[2023–24 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] and the three relegated sides from the [[2023–24 Saudi Pro League|Saudi Pro League]]. [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] were the first team to be relegated following a 4–1 home defeat to [[Al Hilal SFC|Al-Hilal]] on 11 May 2024.{{cite web |title="بالركاده".... الهلال يحسم الدوري ويصادق على هبوط الحزم |url=https://al-hadath.com/sport-news/72144/%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%AF%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D9%82-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%87%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B2%D9%85}} Al-Hazem were relegated after just one year in the top flight. This was their third relegation in five years. Both [[Abha Club|Abha]] and [[Al-Tai FC|Al-Tai]] were relegated on the final day of the season. Abha were relegated following a 2–1 defeat away to Al-Hazem.{{cite web |title=بعد 5 مواسم.. الحزم يسحب أبها إلى يلو |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/841096}} [[Al-Tai FC|Al-Tai]] were relegated following a 2–0 home defeat to [[Al-Okhdood Club|Al-Okhdood]].{{cite web |title=الطائي يهبط .. والأخدود يفلت |date=27 May 2024 |url=https://www.alyaum.com/article/6532295}} Abha were relegated after five seasons in the top flight while Al-Tai were relegated after three seasons. Abha will play in their 20th season in the FD League, while Al-Hazem will play in their 15th season and Al-Tai in their 23rd season. The first club to be promoted was [[Al-Jubail Club|Al-Jubail]] who did so after a 1–1 draw against [[Bisha FC|Bisha]] on 16 March 2024.{{cite web |title=لأول مرة في تاريخه الجبيل إلى دوري الدرجة الأولى يلو |url=https://nabd.com/s/134357801-512132/%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%AE%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%88}} On 22 March 2024, [[Neom SC|Neom]] became the second club to be promoted following a 3–2 win against [[Al-Zulfi FC|Al-Zulfi]].{{cite web |title=بثلاثية.. نيوم يكسب الزلفي ويصعد إلى يلو |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/835906}} The third and final club to be promoted was [[Al-Zulfi FC|Al-Zulfi]], who did so following a 3–0 aggregate win over [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]] in the promotion play-offs on 17 April 2024.{{cite web |title=صعود الزلفي «طواحين نجد» إلى دوري الدرجة الأولى «يلو» |url=https://www.alriyadh.com/2070542}} Neom were crowned champions for the first time after defeating Al-Jubail 3–2 in the final.{{cite web |title=تتويج نادي نيوم بكأس دوري الدرجة الثانية لموسم 2023-2024 |url=https://www.saff.com.sa/news.php?id=2971}} Neom return to the [[Saudi First Division League|First Division League]] after an absence of 12 years. They return to the league for the first time since the 2011–12 season and will play in their 2nd overall season. In addition, this will be their first season in the FDL since their name change. Both Al-Jubail and Al-Zulfi were promoted to the First Division League for the first time in history. ===Stadium and personnel===
